welcome.title: What Does It Mean to Have a Record Expunged?
welcome.details:
If a charge is successfully expunged, it will be cleared or dismissed from public record. An expunged record should no longer be a barrier when you apply for employment, licensing, and housing. 
</br></br>Pursuing an expungement can allow you to take control of your background check and potentially lead to more opportunities.

testimonialQuote.quote: I made one mistake a long time ago and because of that I couldn’t volunteer for sunday school or coach in my kid’s youth sports league. Expungement opened new doors for me and my family.

petition.title: File Petition

information.title: Expungements Questionnaire
information.details:
Below is a list of questions that will help us determine if you are eligible for our expungement service. Please do your best to answer the questions as accurately as possible. Inaccurate responses could negatively impact your expungement petition and your processing fee will be forfeited.

At this time, we can only support expungement petitions for records that meet certain criteria. If you do not qualify for our service, you may still be eligible to file the expungement with another service provider. Let’s take the first steps together.

panelA.title: We teamed up with Lawyaw to process your expungement
panelA.details:
Legal fees for the filing of an expungement petition are often more than $1500. We have partnered with Lawyaw to expedite the filing process, lower costs, and make this opportunity more accessible to you.

Your expungement will cost $500, which goes towards:

  • Court filing fees
  • Legal services
  • Preparation of the expungement petition

If there’s an inaccuracy with your questionnaire, Lawyaw might not be able to properly process your expungement petition. In the event that this occurs, the $500 fee is non-refundable.

panelB.title: The expungement process usually takes 30 days.
panelB.details: The entire process, from preparing your expungement petition to waiting for the court’s decision, usually takes 30 days to complete, but will vary depending on your court’s discretion. This may be longer due to the COVID-19 crisis. We will contact you if we need further information or if your record is not eligible for expungement.

panelC.title: We will contact you when the expungement process is complete.
panelC.details: If your record is expunged, that record should no longer appear in most background checks when you apply for housing, occupational licenses, or employment.

titlePanel.title: Your Record Does Not Qualify
titlePanel.details: Based on your answers, your record does not qualify for our expungement process; though you may still be eligible for an expungement elsewhere.

reasonPanel.title: Why Was I Disqualified?
reasonPanel.details: This isn’t a legal questionnaire that is comprehensive for your eligibility with regards to the State. Our process is one we created with our partner Lawyaw to streamline and reduce costs. We recommend seeking other legal counsel who may be able to expunge this record on your behalf.

nextStepsPanel.title: What can I do now?
nextStepsPanel.details:
While our vendor does not qualify you for an expungement, you may still be eligible for an expungement elsewhere.

Here are some resources:

  • Resource

information.title: See if you qualify for a free marijuana expungement
information.details:
Checkr is launching an expungement service that offers some of the lowest rates nationwide. To kick off our initiative, we are sponsoring 100 expungements for eligible job-seekers, who have marijuana charges in California and Colorado. You recently had your background check run through Checkr and we found that you may have an eligible record.

Please complete the questionnaire below and we’ll let you know if you qualify for a free expungement.

Whether or not you qualify for the free expungement is not indicative of whether you qualify for an expungement in general.

questions.court_supervision: Are you currently on probation or under court supervision?
questions.probation_completed: Did you complete your probation without any problems?
questions.any_arrests_since: Have you been arrested and / or convicted of any crimes since this conviction?
questions.charge_impact: How much has this marijuana charge negatively impacted your life?
questions.personal_story: Please explain what opportunities have been blocked because of your marijuana charge.
questions.share_story: Would you be willing to share your story on our website, either with your name or anonymously?
questions.prefer_email_vs_text: Would you prefer to be contacted by email or text message?
questions.inform_of_launch: If you are not selected for a sponsorship, do you want to be informed about the launch of our expungement service where you can pay to have your record expunged?
questions.data_consent: I agree to share my information with Checkr and their third-party vendor, Lawyaw, to determine eligibility and process my expungement petition.

success.reach_out: We will reach out to you if you qualify for a Checkr-sponsored expungement, or if any further action is needed on your part.
success.qualifier: If you do not qualify for a free expungement through this program, your record may still be expungeable.

deleteData.title: Are You Sure You Want to Delete?
deleteData.info:
Your data will be removed from our platform.

Deleting your data may affect your engagement status with the company or companies that have run a background check through Checkr. You should reach out to these companies to understand what impact, if any, deletion of your data may have on your engagement status.

After you delete your data, you will no longer be able to access your information, including your background check reports,through our Candidate Portal.

Deleting your data is a manual process, which may take up to 30 days to complete.

finesHaveBeenPaidInformation.explanation:
Please note that violation records are reported directly by your state Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV). Paying off a ticket or satisfying a court order does not always remove a violation from your driving record. As long as a violation is being reported on your driving record by your state DMV, it will be included on your motor vehicle report (MVR).

In some cases, you may be able to have a violation record amended or removed from your driving record by contacting your DMV directly. For more information, visit our Help Center.

causeConsiderStatusInformation.explanation:
A "Consider" status simply means that there is information on your report. That information will be reviewed by the company you applied with. "Consider" does not indicate anything about the final decision the company will make.

For more information, visit our Help Center or contact the company you applied with for hiring or engagement decisions.
